resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1947 Eugene paper reports a planned lookout with work to start July 1, 1947. The register and firelookout.com both give 1948 as the year it was built. The record's 1948 is kept, with the 1947 plan noted.
The register says removed in 1966 and firelookout.com says destroyed in 1966. Both agree on the year; the story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: Good newspaper and register coverage for 1947 to 1955, but the record's 1948 build year and 1966 removal rest on the register and firelookout.com, and the two disagree on removed versus destroyed. Elevation differs across sources: the register gives 3,045 ft (928 m), a hiking guide gives 3,058 ft, and an encyclopedia summary gives 3,028 ft; a 1947 clipping calls the peak 5,000 ft, which looks wrong. The register lists the kind as ground while its description says a cabin on a short tower; a human may want to check that field. The register's photo caption is credited to a private collection, so no photo was added. No source found covers the lookout after 1955 except the 1966 removal date and the demolition note.
